decisions.reason: The supplement range has its own page and is sold through pharmacies, close to the firm's existing OTC knowledge and channels, so the firm can read early results and refine it.
This skin and hair supplement was actively launched in pharmacies on its own page, and its formulation and claims build on the firm's established pharmaceutical and OTC know-how.
The joint health product extends the established Trivital brand, so it builds on existing brand and formulation knowledge that eases learning and improvement.
A mushroom-based immune supplement is further from the firm's core pharmaceutical knowledge and gets only a mention online, so interpreting its results is harder, but it is too early to drop it.

The 2018 valsartan recall was an external problem with a contaminated ingredient, not a product failure, and the firm's core generics expertise lets it re-source the ingredient and reintroduce the product rather than abandon it.
